content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Metics Media: Content Creator - Youtube Anywhere in the World Zug Content Creation All Other Remote Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6763/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Switzerland <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://meticsmedia.com">https://meticsmedia.com</a> </p> <h3><strong>Job Overview</strong></h3> <p>Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.</p> <h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.</p> <p>We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.</p> <p>We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.</li> <li>Write video scripts and outlines.</li> <li>Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.</li> <li>Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Native-level written and spoken English</li> <li>Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners</li> <li>Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it</li> <li>AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity</li> <li>High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work</li> <li>Ability to take feedback and continuously improve</li> <li>Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects</li> <li>Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics</li> <li>A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise</li> <li>Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload</li> <li>Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Previous experience creating educational video content</li> <li>Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about</li> <li>Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Working at Metics Media</strong></h3> <p>At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.</p> <p>At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.</p> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US based), $80,000 CAD per year (Canada based)</li> <li>Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly</li> <li>For reference, our current US-based creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How to apply</strong></h3> <p>Please submit your application on our website: <a href="https://join.meticsmedia.com/">https://join.meticsmedia.com</a></p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube</a></p> Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:59:29 +0000 Sun, 13 Dec 2026 13:59:29 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube D2B: Senior Performance Marketing Manager - Dayshift Remote Asia Only Data Analysis, Project Management, Looker Studio, Google Ads, Technical SEO, and Lead Generation Sales and Marketing Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6762/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Philippines <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b">https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b</a> </p> <p></p><p>Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager</p><p>Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly</p><p>Working Hours &amp; Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays</p><p>Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor&nbsp;</p><p></p><p>ABOUT THE COMPANY:&nbsp;</p><p></p><p>The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation.
